data.one_liner: Facilitates inspection and modification of local storage inside a Flutter app.
data.what_it_does: A Flutter plugin that allows developers to inspect and modify local storage at runtime using a companion IDE plugin. It supports registering servers for preferences, secure storage, files, and databases.
use_when: You want to inspect and modify app databases, preferences, and files during development
You are using an IntelliJ-based IDE and want to use the companion Local Storage Inspector plugin
avoid_when: You are building for production and want to disable storage inspection for security reasons
You do not use an IntelliJ-based IDE and have no alternative client to connect to the storage server
strengths: Allows runtime inspection and modification of local storage, files, and databases
Supports customizable servers for custom storage solutions
weaknesses: Specific implementation servers have been split into their own separate packages
Requires external IDE plugin for full visualization capability
data.setup_notes: Create a StorageServerDriver, register storage servers, and start the driver.
